title: Layout editor evidence panel toggle
summary: Added a Layout Editor Evidence toggle that can mark a layout-managed panel as read-only evidence using the existing browser-local layout preference state.
reason: Operators could reorder, hide, and Advanced-gate panels from the Layout Editor, but could not classify an interactive/readout panel as evidence so it follows the global Hide Evidence preference.
behavior_before: Layout Editor rows offered move, visibility, and Advanced-gate controls only. Panel evidence classification came only from authored markup or generated inference.
behavior_after: Layout Editor rows include an Evidence toggle. Non-evidence panels can be marked as evidence, persist a panelType evidence override in mediapipeline-layout-v1, follow Hide Evidence, and restore to their authored panel type when toggled off or reset.
manual_validation: change packet finalized for Layout Editor Evidence toggle
